uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: While at 50% max HP or below, increases Attack by 5% and movement speed by 12%. While HP is at 50% or less, Attack and movement speed are increased.

Auto attacks differ depending on range, and become boosted attacks with every third attack, dealing increased damage. Auto attacks used at long range reduce the cooldown of Bubble, Water Shuriken, or Surf by 0.5s when they hit. Boosted attacks used at long range also decrease the movement speed of the opposing Pokémon hit by 25% for 0.5s. Auto attacks used in close range instead deal a bonus 5% missing HP damage to opposing Pokémon hit. Boosted attacks used in close range dash through the target, dealing a bonus 10% missing HP damage to opposing Pokémon hit instead. Against wild Pokémon: the missing HP damage of auto attacks used in close range is capped at 500. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. At long range, a boosted attack deals increased damage to enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time. At close range, a boosted attack deals more damage the lower the enemies remaining HP is.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. At long range, a boosted attack deals increased damage to enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time. At close range, a boosted attack deals more damage the lower the enemies remaining HP is.

Sprays 2 bubbles in the designated direction which pop when they hit an opposing Pokémon, damaging opposing Pokémon and decreasing their movement speed by 25% for 1s when each bubble hits. Attack with a spray of bubbles, decreasing the movement speed of enemies when it hits.

Increases movement speed by 25% for 3s and throws 4 shurikens made of water in the designated direction which explode when they hit an opposing Pokémon, damaging nearby opposing Pokémon and decreasing their movement speed by 35% for 1s when each shuriken hits; and restoring HP for each opposing Pokémon hit. Throw shurikens made of water in quick succession. Decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time and restores the user's HP when it hits. Also increases the user's movement speed while using this move.
Throws 5 shurikens. Increases the number of shurikens thrown.

Dashes on a wave forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in the path and restoring HP for each target hit. Deals bonus damage to opposing Pokémon below 50% max HP. If this move hits and the user knocks out an opposing Pokémon before it goes on cooldown, the cooldown of this move is reset. Against wild Pokémon: the damage of the wave is capped at 1200; bonus damage is capped at 600. Ride a wave, dealing damage to enemies and restoring the user's HP. If this move knocks out an enemy, its cooldown is reset. In addition, this move deals increased damage to enemies with low HP.
Increases the HP restored by this move. Increases the amount of HP restored.

Becomes invincible and dashes forward, leaving behind a Substitute doll in their place which lasts for 3s. The Substitute doll has the same HP, Defense and Sp. Def as the user; the Substitute doll receives 500% of the damage the user would take. Leaves behind a substitute doll for the user while it's moving forward.

Briefly vanishes then becomes unstoppable and dashes forward, sending two illusionary copies diagonally behind which last for 3s. The copies have the same HP, Defense and Sp. Def as Greninja when created, but receive 500% of the damage they would otherwise take. The clones attack nearby opposing Pokémon with Bubble, Water Shuriken, or Surf (whichever move the user has learned), and auto attacks; but deal 15% of the damage they would otherwise deal. Quickly moves the user away from the current position, creating illusory copies of it to aid in battle.
Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s. Reduced cooldown.

Becomes unstoppable and dashes forward, increasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s, entering stealth for 2s, readying a boosted attack that deals increased damage, and leaving behind a cloud of smoke which lasts for 3s. Exits stealth when using an attack. Opposing Pokémon in the cloud of smoke have their field of vision reduced by 60%. Creates a smokescreen and has the user roll away from its current location. Immediately afterward, the user begins sneaking and has its movement speed increased for a short time. This also makes its next basic attack a boosted attack.
Increases Attack by 20% for 2s when exiting stealth. Increased attack for a short time when the user stops sneaking.

Becomes unstoppable and leaps up to throw a giant water shuriken toward the designated circular location, damaging opposing Pokémon it hits on the way to the circular area of effect (from beyond the range of the user's close range auto attacks) and decreasing the movement speed of those hit by 50% for 2s. The user then suddenly appears on top of the water shuriken which immediately bursts, damaging opposing Pokémon in the circular area of effect again and throwing them. Leaps off the burst water shuriken and becomes vulnerable to hindrances again as they jump down to the ground in the direction of their choosing. Throw a giant water shuriken toward the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time when this move hits. The water shuriken then immediately explodes, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throws them. Once this move ends, the user may jump in a designated direction.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

source.name: Waterburst Shuriken
source.originalDescription: Becomes unstoppable and leaps up to throw a giant water shuriken toward the designated circular location, damaging opposing Pokémon it hits on the way to the circular area of effect (from beyond the range of the user's close range auto attacks) and decreasing the movement speed of those hit by 50% for 2s. The user then suddenly appears on top of the water shuriken which immediately bursts, damaging opposing Pokémon in the circular area of effect again and throwing them. Leaps off the burst water shuriken and becomes vulnerable to hindrances again as they jump down to the ground in the direction of their choosing. Throw a giant water shuriken toward the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time when this move hits. The water shuriken then immediately explodes, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throws them. Once this move ends, the user may jump in a designated direction.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Waterburst Shuriken は 相手を打ち上げる、妨害無効になる。
